formula_reviews.location: tangent_core.py prepare: U,W,E; weight_A; rho_b; pi_b_kernel
formula_reviews.reason: U_b=2U and W_b=-4W produce rho_b=-6pi and the nonpositive expanded pi_b numerator. weight_A contains both packet derivative and finite reference-normalization quotient term. No small-Z_A substitution occurs.

delta logH includes b, normalized shear v, both radiation energy monopoles, and the direct A density derivative with the correct factor 1/(2H²). d_b,d_A and radiation quadrupole coefficients form delta D. Inert tau/u inputs stay absent as in the pinned fm>0 source.

The signs of -T delta logH, T delta v-B delta logH, -3 delta v+C(deltaD-D delta logH), and all radiation product-rule terms agree with independent derivation. State and A directions are propagated together; batched columns reuse the same prepared geometry.

bar_B combines b-output and radiation flows, bar_h includes the time, shear-ratio and forcing normalizations, and each radiation block uses the transposed original matrix. F_A cotangent contains both H and pressure pathways. Numerical pairing is supplementary to the explicit transpose derivation.

Km/Kr scale as 1-S²/6; A_theta and k_theta carry the S normalization terms; y0_v derivative is 6/(6-S²)^(3/2); all four ell2 initial rows receive k_theta/5. The documented signed extension makes the zero-shear derivative well-defined without reclassifying historical positive-shear rows.

Each component retains H^-2 normalization; radiation and matter derivatives are signed and the total derivative is added before any norm. The accepted code captures actual rho_crit and kappa_t rather than reducing the observable factor to normalized forcing constants.

findings.target: Initial tangent_core.py obs_factor grouped kappa_t*rho_crit as 3H0².
findings.evidence: First-read code SHA256 ff2b0c9690d98ca0f63023dff38c0a19f8426cfea70d04ac07c08f1c0e11c758 used sqrt6*3H0²/H² while the original adapter builds SI observables from kappa_t and rho_crit.
findings.impact: Mathematically equivalent for the pinned source, but obscures the intended SI source path and alters floating-point grouping. This was not identified as a finite-field physical sign error.
findings.resolution: Root added _KAPPA_TIME and snapshot source.rhocrit_j_m3, then used sqrt6*_KAPPA_TIME*_rho_crit/H².
findings.closure: Read corrected lines and executed original SI-observable and observable-JVP comparisons. Closed at accepted hash3d5020ee…

qualifications: Acceptance concerns derivatives of the smooth finite-sum model, not derivatives of floating-point rounding.
Original pi=(pa-pp)/3 and the adapter's single signed packet reduction are equal as finite mathematical sums; numerical equivalence is tested, not byte equivalence claimed.
make_model recomputes the same mathematical calibration with a declared signed extension and z2 endpoint; the historical trajectories remain frozen evidence.
The source hash gate is executed by the pinned owner-model entry path; arbitrary externally modified model matrices are outside this source-identity acceptance.
Only signed observable Jacobians are accepted at zero stresses; a differentiable absolute norm at zero is not claimed.
New API guards and NCP scheduler execution need their own code tests/review. No automatic scope extension of this review.
